name: Hlohovec (Slovakia)
description: Eight equal horizontal stripes of white, white, blue, blue, white, white, blue and blue, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature H-3/1991.
